newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse in positive territory.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse in positive territory.

text.p: Germany's 30-share DAX index ended bourse trade on Wednesday strongly ahead, just off record highs, continuing its powerful advance of recent weeks and putting the Tuesday's turbulent trade firmly behind it.

The blue-chip DAX index built on the seemingly-unstoppable rise of the dollar against the mark to end the floor session at 3,028.67 points, up 51.96 points or 1.75 percent, having gone as high as 3,041.55 points earlier in the session.
